s1.description: Opening: retrieval warm-up, outcomes and the 3-hour plan

s2.description: Block 1: Galerkin weighted residual, integration by parts in two dimensions, and the meaning of [k], {q} and {b}

s3.description: Block 2: closed-form evaluation of the conductance matrix, the heat-generation vector and the boundary-flux vector

s4.description: Block 3: the worked-example mesh, global numbering and the connectivity table that maps local to global degrees of freedom

s5.description: Block 4: assembly of the global system by scatter-add, imposition of Dirichlet conditions by row–column elimination, and the hand solution

s6.description: Block 5: interpolation at a point with local coordinates, flux recovery, mesh refinement and comparison with software

s7.description: Block 6: line-by-line trace of the text’s MATLAB script, Assignment 4 briefing, exit ticket and preparation for plane stress
